prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
For the third quarter of 2026, the provision for credit losses on loans was a reversal of $867 thousand compared to $1.3 million for the third quarter of 2025. The decrease was driven by net loan recoveries of $419 thousand during the quarter, and a decrease in the historical loss rate used in the calculation of the AC due to an update to the Bank's peer group. The ACL ratio for loans was 1.32% on September 30, 2026 and 1.32% on December 31, 2025. See the Loan Quality discussion for additional information on these loans.

The provision for credit losses on unfunded commitments was $1.4 million compared to reversal of $53 thousand for the same period in 2025. The increase was due to the establishment of a $1.5 million reserve on a letter of credit related to a non-accrual CRE construction loan. The ACL for unfunded commitments was $3.4 million on September 30, 2026 and $1.9 million on December 31, 2025.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonint.text: Noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 decreased $756 thousand compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was primarily in employee benefits related to the Ban's self-insured health insurance plan, which declined from $1.2 million for the third quarter of 2025 to $697 thousand for the third quarter of 2026.

nonop.heading: Noninterest Expense
nonop.text: Noninterest expense for the third quarter of 2026 decreased $756 thousand compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was primarily in employee benefits related to the Ban's self-insured health insurance plan, which declined from $1.2 million for the third quarter of 2025 to $697 thousand for the third quarter of 2026.

tax.heading: Provision for Income Taxes
tax.text: For the third quarter of 2026, total income tax was $2.1 million, which was comprised of $2.0 million in Federal income tax and $99 thousand in state income taxes. Income tax for the third quarter of 2026 increased by $818 thousand compared to the third quarter of 2025, due to higher pre-tax income in 2026. The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was 19.9% compared to 19.6% for the same period in 2025. The federal statutory tax rate is 21% for 2026 and 2025.

intro.text: Franklin Financial Services Corporation (the “Corporation”) was organized as a Pennsylvania business corporation on June 1, 1983 and is a registered bank holding company under the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended (the “BHCA”). On January 16, 1984, pursuant to a plan of reorganization approved by the shareholders of Farmers and Merchants Trust Company of Chambersburg (“F&M Trust” or “the Bank”) and the appropriate regulatory agencies, the Corporation exchanged all of the shares of F&M Trust and issued its own shares of the Corporation to former F&M Trust shareholders on a one share – for - one share basis.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Debt securities
lines.why: Bonds held for sale or to maturity: financial.

lines.name: Equity securities
lines.why: Shares held for their return: financial.

lines.name: Loans, net of the allowance
lines.why: Lending is a bank's business: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Deposits
lines.why: Customers' money a bank holds is its business: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
